compute_r_squared_metric: compute the R-squared coefficient of determination for predictions against reference values
load_r_squared_metric: load the r_squared metric from the HuggingFace evaluate library for regression model evaluation
get_r_squared_info: get the r_squared metric metadata including description, citation, and input features
evaluate_regression_fit: evaluate regression model goodness of fit using R-squared score on predictions and references
compare_predictions_accuracy: compare prediction accuracy against true values using R-squared metric rounded to 3 decimal places
